home.lead: A detached house surrounded by Mediterranean shrubs, 10 metres from the sea. Three bedrooms, sleeps 6 + 2.
home.houseBody: Three bedrooms, each with a double bed, plus a sofa bed: sleeps 6 + 2. Two full bathrooms with shower, WC and bidet; one is en-suite. A full kitchen and a living room with a fireplace. Air conditioning in the bedrooms, Wi-Fi. Linen and towels included, beach towels too.
home.seaBody: Step out of the front door and you are on Simius beach: a one-minute walk. We have beach umbrellas if you need them.
home.outsideLead: A terrace with a sun deck, well-equipped porches for eating outdoors, a garden, a barbecue and a hot outdoor shower.
home.whereBody: Simius, Villasimius, in the south of Sardinia.
